IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ScheduledWorkflowExecution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[ScheduledWorkflowExecution]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [EventID] [int] NOT NULL, [instanceID] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [ExecutionDate] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ScheduledWorkflowExecution] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, OPTIMIZE_FOR_SEQUENTIAL_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY]
ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ScheduledWorkflowExecution] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ScheduledWorkflowExecution_WorkflowEventRegistration] FOREIGN KEY([EventID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[EventRegistration] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ScheduledWorkflowExecution] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ScheduledWorkflowExecution_WorkflowEventRegistration] END
